messages:
maria_cs: FYI — Zenora Labs flagged an org-wide ramp request just now. Legal, Marketing, and DS want to roll out internal tools that call our APIs. They estimate ~6 squads onboarding over the next 6 weeks, ~1.2M tokens/day steady state, embeddings ~60k/week. Renewal is in ~90 days — they said if we can't show a path to predictable costs + region support they may rethink renewal.

aj_eng: thanks — do we have concurrency/qps numbers? sequence lengths? any special models they require (long-context, embedding + chat combos)?

maria_cs: quick notes from the call: morning ingest batches spike latency; interactive product calls avg 300-600 tokens; a handful of truncation/long-context trials for legal summarization (up to 8k). They want EU region hosting and per-team quotas.

tom_pm: seems like Dedicated or Private pilot makes sense. Short checklist: 1) capacity profile (qps + seq) 2) cost projection 3) enablement plan 4) SLA ask. Can eng produce a draft capacity plan by EOD?

aj_eng: we can run sizing based on their numbers. rough concurrent qps if 1.2M tokens/day with 400 tokens/request -> ~3000 requests/day => ~1.7 rps average, but peak could be 6-8x. if peak 15 rps and long-context models we should size for 30 rps headroom.

jess_success: i'll schedule an enablement workshop (dev + security + legal) for next Tue/Wed. also will capture specific failure modes they saw: morning latency spikes, and a retry storm they mentioned.

maria_cs: also asked about per-team billing and soft rate-limits so each squad can't blow budget. They want a single invoice but per-team usage breakdown.

oliver_fin: we can provide per-route usage reports and CSVs. if they want committed capacity pricing, we should get a T-shirt estimate to inform commercial.

tom_pm: aj — can you draft a pilot config snippet we could propose? Something like: 
```
pilot: {
  type: "dedicated",
  region: "eu-west-1",
  capacity: "2x A10G equiv (burst to 4x)",
  expected_peak_rps: "30",
  kv_cache: true,
  quant_profile: "int8_mixed"
}
```
Use that to run cost sims.

aj_eng: will do. also need to know their SLO for 95th pct latency. maria — can you get that before the workshop?

maria_cs: asked for "sub-second token latency" on interactive calls and "<500ms" p95 for common prompts — sounds optimistic but it's their ask.

jess_success: capturing enablement items: onboarding guide, route-level quotas, workspace setup, API key rotation, EU data residency docs. I'll attach a pre-read.

zenora-bot: "Zenora: uploaded usage export for past 30 days -> zenora_30d.csv" :file_folder:

aj_eng: got the export. there's a daily spike at 08:30 UTC, likely batch jobs. i'll run a profile and post numbers by EOD.

oliver_fin: based on initial numbers i'll sketch a committed pilot price band and options (payg vs committed). will sync with sales.

tom_pm: next steps: aj to post capacity simulation + tentative config, oliver to post pricing bands, jess schedule workshop & pre-read, maria to confirm exact SLOs and team list. aim to present a pilot offer to Zenora in 5 business days. :spiral_calendar_pad: 

maria_cs: noted. also flagging renewal risk up front in account — if we don't get a clear pilot and predictable cost path they'll escalate to procurement. tagging @tom_pm for exec alignment. :warning:

jess_success: adding tasks to the enablement board and will invite engineering to the workshop. short answers only in channel please until we lock dates. :thumbsup:
